Hi Aurelia —

Heading into your renewal window, we wanted to share a concise "scaleplay" proposal that covers the EU primary residency commitment and an APAC warm-standby pilot. Key points below and an attached draft SOW (SOW_v2_MedixPro.pdf):

- Renewal term: 12 months with a baseline reserved capacity (50k inference units/mo) and a 30% commit top-up option for Q1 surge
- Residency: EU primary (Frankfurt) for PHI-adjacent workloads; APAC warm-standby (Singapore) for DR and burst only
- Failover: application-level cross-region failover using smart routing + read-only KV sync; full traffic failover only under agreed playbook
- SLAs: keep current 99.9% uptime for EU; APAC pilot will be best-effort during the pilot month

Next steps / asks:
